title: Bound live state projections and replace whole-host mutation responses with compact results
outcome: State HTTP/SSE and mutation acknowledgements scale with subscribed/live data using existing revision/diff owners, without confusing projection absence with deletion.
acceptance: Define and enforce aggregate byte/cardinality budgets for state snapshots, initial/recovery/legacy state and diffs, including nested queues, readiness, model data and test runs; use existing snapshot/diff owners.

Session/project/settings/message/queue/thread/approval mutation responses do not require a full host snapshot merely to report a committed or accepted operation; response failures preserve truthful outcome and existing reconciliation.
Clients distinguish deleted from not projected, fetch referenced entities by id, retain workspace references/preferences and avoid unknown-session delta resync loops; totals/search are truthful.
Reuse existing session archive and delegation projections; cover remaining collections, preserve revision/baseline recovery, and pass independent review/full gate with bounded-size tests.
